units.source_text: 话分两头，且说源氏公子在须磨，日子渐久，恋念紫姬之心无可再忍，极想接她来此同居。

en.t: Meanwhile, as Prince Genji stayed longer and longer at Suma, his longing for Lady Murasaki became unbearable, and he desperately wanted to bring her there to live with him.

units.source_text: 但念自身为了宿世业障，流离至此，岂可再拉这可爱的人儿落水？

en.t: But then he thought that he himself had been driven into exile by karmic burdens from a former life, and wondered how he could drag that beloved person down into the same misfortune.

units.source_text: 终觉此事不妥，便打消了这念头。

en.t: In the end he felt that it would not be right, and so he gave up the idea.

units.source_text: 这天涯海角，凡事与京都不同。

en.t: In this far-off corner of the world, everything was different from Kyoto.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了从未见过的平民百姓的生活，由于看不惯，不胜惊奇，觉得自己目前的境遇有些委屈。

en.t: Prince Genji saw the lives of ordinary common people, something he had never witnessed before, and because he was unused to it, he was deeply astonished and felt somewhat wronged by his present circumstances.

units.source_text: 附近常常有烟雾吹进屋里来。

en.t: Smoke from nearby often blew into the house.

units.source_text: 源氏公子以为是渔夫烧盐的烟雾，实则寓所后面的山上有人在烧柴。

en.t: Prince Genji thought it was smoke from fishermen boiling salt, but in fact someone was burning brushwood on the mountain behind his dwelling.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了觉得纳罕，便赋诗云：

en.t: Prince Genji saw it and found it strange, and so he composed a poem:
